A **Traditional IRA** lets you deduct your contributions now—like getting a tax break before you even see the money. But when you withdraw, you pay taxes later—on your “golden harvest.”

A **Roth IRA**, on the other hand, means you pay taxes now, but once the money grows, it’s *free* from taxes when you withdraw—especially after age 59½. The golden rule? It’s your own money, your own rules, your own luck.
